question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution: The correct answer is **"tests."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Tests"** is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. • The verb** "tests"** means to evaluate or examine something to determine its quality, performance, or knowledge. (किसी वस्‍तु को सावधानी से आज़माना, इस्‍तेमाल करना या परखना (जानने के लिए कि वह कैसी है या क्‍या है)) • **Example**: *All of these papers have been **tested**__.* • The sentence suggests that something is being evaluated or examined. • The word** "tests"** is grammatically correct in the sentence. • The correct answer is Option 4. • **Correct passage**: A puzzle is a game, challenge, or toy that __**tests**__ one’s inventiveness or knowledge. The solver of a puzzle is supposed to ______ (2) ______ parts together logically to arrive at the correct or enjoyable solution to the challenge. Crossword puzzles, word-search puzzles, number puzzles, relational puzzles, and logic puzzles are examples of puzzle ______ (3) ______. Puzzles are frequently developed for fun purposes, but they may also result from ______ (4) ______ mathematical or logical challenges. In such circumstances, its answer might make an important ______ (5) ______ to mathematical research. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** __ • **"Enjoys" **means to take pleasure in something or find it enjoyable. ((किसी वस्‍तु का) आनंद लेना) • **Example**: *She enjoys **reading**__ books.* • **"Elicits" **means to draw out a response or reaction from someone or something. (किसी से सूचना, तथ्‍य आदि निकलवाना) __ • **Example**:* The comedian's joke **elicited**__ laughter from the audience.* • **"Invokes" **means to call upon or appeal to something, usually a higher power or authority. ((किसी कार्य के समर्थन में) नियम, क़ानून आदि प्रयोग करना) __ • **Example**: *The politician **invoked**__ the Constitution in his speech.* 3e:Tf05, The correct answer is **"fit."**
